name: Activity
description: One panel for what each agent did and what needs you: its latest closing message as a running recap, notes agents leave with ostia activity add, and items that need you with a count in the sidebar until you mark them done. On request it shows the prompt, tool calls and stops of each turn as a timeline, with the workspace's events beside them: panes started, closed, hibernated or woken, agent status, folder changes and, once you grant read-bus, which pane sent a bus message to which, never what it says. It keeps everything on this computer, moves old entries to a compressed archive, and never types into a terminal.
